basic_details.job_title: DHFWO Yadgir Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.organization_name: District Health and Family Welfare Office
basic_details.short_information: District Health and Family Welfare Office Yadgir (DHFWO Yadgir) has published the Nursing Officer Notification 2026 on its official website, https://yadgir.nic.in. The recruitment drive aims to fill 8 Nursing Officer positions on a contractual basis. Candidates who fulfill the prescribed age limit and educational qualification as mentioned in the official notification are eligible to apply online. The application process will remain open up to 09 August 2026, and candidates can access the official notification PDF and online application link below.

selection_process: Please refer to the official notification for selection process details.
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the DHFWO Yadgir Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of DHFWO Yadgir to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DHFWO Yadgir Data Entry Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Data Entry Operator posts is 09 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies announced for the Data Entry Operator position by the District Health and Family Welfare Office, Yadgir.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the DHFWO Yadgir Data Entry Operator recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the job type for the Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: The Data Entry Operator positions are offered on a contractual basis by DHFWO Yadgir.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read it thoroughly.

faq.answer: The official website for DHFWO Yadgir is https://yadgiri.nic.in. You can visit this site for more information and to apply.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee mentioned for the Data Entry Operator posts?
faq.answer: As per the available information, no specific application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.answer: The application start date is 31 July 2026, and the last date to apply is 09 August 2026. Mark these dates to avoid missing out.
